description: space.rs handle_space_join (invite code path): the invite.uses counter is incremented at line 625-628 BEFORE the already_member check at line 683-690. If the calling account is already a member of the space, the function returns an error ('account is already a member') -- but the uses counter has already been incremented.\n\nFor invites with maxUses set, this silently burns a use on a failed join attempt. A user who accidentally tries to rejoin a space depletes the invite's use count. The correct order is: check already_member first, then increment uses only after confirming the join will proceed.
title: Space/join: invite uses incremented before already_member check
